Lint Support Linting and Formatting integration for Travetto

Oxlint, Oxfmt, and CSpell are the tools used for linting, formatting, and spell checking in Typescript and Javascript code. This module provides a unified CLI interface and standard linting, formatting, and spell checking configurations. In a new project, the first thing that will need to be done, post installation, is to register the configuration files.

CLI - lint:register

When registration completes, this bootstraps the configuration files the linter, formatter, and spell checker will use, as well as editor tooling (e.g. IDEs).

CLI - lint:check
